motivating_context: This protocol closes out the original team brief this project's research began from: analyst + order-block trader + ICT trader + price-action trader, collaborating creatively with good risk management as the explicit goal. Order-block structure (S17+), killzone selectivity (S13/S21), price-action rejection (S8v2/S17b) and risk management (S19/S20/S22's patient breakeven+chandelier exit, sizing) were all tested extensively. The one classic ICT concept never tested standalone in the S16-S30 lineage is premium/discount: only take a long retest in the cheaper half of the recent trading range, a short retest in the more expensive half — 'buy low, sell high' relative to recent structure, not just relative to the order block itself. Its formula already exists in gates_b.check_premium_discount for the live scanner but was never wired into this causal backtest pipeline.

hypotheses.entry_exit: identical to S20 H1 (order block + OI confirmation, regime, OBV flow, patient breakeven/chandelier exit) PLUS: the retest close must sit below the midpoint of the trailing 320-bar (80h/~3.3 day) 15m swing high/low for a long, above the midpoint for a short
hypotheses.swing_range: rolling 320-bar high/low on the same 15m series S20 already computes — no new data source, no separate HTF fetch

hypotheses.entry_exit: identical to H1 EXCEPT the required zone is the tighter classic ICT 'optimal trade entry' band: 62-79% retracement from the recent swing extreme, not the full 50% half-range

single_variable_isolated: Both hypotheses add exactly one new required condition (premium/discount zone) on top of S20 H1, unchanged otherwise. H2 differs from H1 only in how tight that zone is (half-range vs 62-79% OTE band, both pre-existing, named ICT conventions — not swept parameters).

symbols.note: Reuses the exact same cached klines/funding/metrics archives already downloaded for S18/S20 — no new data source.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid over the swing lookback (fixed at 320 bars) or OTE band (fixed at the textbook 62-79%). A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Both routes are expected to be materially more selective than S20 H1 (fewer raw candidates pass an added zone condition) and may fall below the 40-fill development minimum — a legitimate, disclosed possible outcome, not grounds to loosen the bar afterward.
Swing range is computed on the same 15m series as everything else (not a true separate HTF fetch), a simplification consistent with this project's other HTF proxies.
Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18/S20.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
